{{Top|leg}}
'''Section 523A''' was a procedural regulation of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] [[Bureaucrat/Legends|bureaucracy]]. During a session of the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]]<ref name="TPM novel">[[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace (novelization)|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''The Phantom Menace'' novelization]]</ref> in [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]],<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Finis Valorum/Legends|Finis Valorum]] reluctantly cited Section 523A in support of [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Lott Dod/Legends|Lott Dod's]] request that a commission be sent to [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] to investigate [[Queen/Legends|Queen]] [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Amidala's]] claim that the Federation's [[Trade Federation Droid Army/Legends|droid armies]] had invaded the [[Planet/Legends|planet]]. Despite Valorum's reluctance<ref name="TPM novel" />&mdash;in fact, he felt that procedural regulations were a plague to the Republic<ref name="Cloak of Deception">''[[Cloak of Deception]]''</ref> and only cited the regulation after receiving advice from the [[Vice Chair/Legends|Vice Chair]] [[Mas Amedda/Legends|Mas Amedda]] and [[Senior Administrative Aide/Legends|Staff Aide]] [[Sei Taria/Legends|Sei Taria]]&mdash;Amidala called a [[Vote of No Confidence/Legends|Vote of No Confidence]] in his leadership, and he was ultimately ousted from his position.<ref name="The Phantom Menace">{{Film|I}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Section 523A is mentioned by Chancellor Valorum in both the script of [[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''The Phantom Menace'']],<ref name="Classic Moment">{{InsiderCite|128|Classic Moment|Classic Moment: Vote of No Confidence}}</ref> and in its [[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace (novelization)|novelization]],<ref name="TPM novel" /> but not in the film itself.<ref name="The Phantom Menace" />
